about:
Assured Automotive Company operates from Mesa, Arizona, where it has served the automotive aftermarket since 1991. The company runs an online store and a physical location at 663 West 2nd Avenue, Suite 23, focusing on truck and UTV accessories.

The company stocks and sells a wide range of truck and side-by-side accessories, including air horns, on-board air systems, LED lighting, bed covers, cold-air intakes, programmers, and suspension components. It carries products from brands such as Rigid Industries, Viair, Edge Products, Air Lift, Firestone, and S&B Filters, among others. All listed items are kept in inventory for immediate shipment, with an average order handling time of less than one business day. The site also offers price matching against competitor dealer prices.

Its customers include individual truck and SUV owners, off-road enthusiasts, and UTV operators across a broad range of vehicle makes — Ford, Chevrolet, GMC, Dodge/Ram, Jeep, Nissan, Toyota, as well as Polaris, Yamaha, and Can-Am side-by-sides.

The company differentiates itself by emphasizing post-sale support and price competitiveness, promising to match or beat competitor dealer prices and maintaining knowledgeable phone support during business hours.
